title: Conducting usability tests
summary: Planned and ran a live usability test of the library app with 5 students: test goal, recruiting representative participants, 3 tasks on the red route, think-aloud protocol, metrics (task success, time on task, errors, SUS score), and ranking findings by severity.
emphasis: This WILL be in IA2 Part B: plan a usability test for a given app - goal, 5 participants, 3 realistic tasks, metrics, and what you would change in the next iteration.
